comments.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
comments.text: 🤯 What shocked me most is that in La Rinconada, some miners may work more than 20 days without pay, then get a short period to mine for themselves and keep whatever gold they find. Their income depends on what is in the rock, not on a guaranteed wage.

replies.author: @uncensoredworld360
replies.text: It's truly a shocking and precarious system, highlighting the extreme lengths people go to for survival.
